notes.title: Summer and Feedback Update is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We hope you’ve been enjoying your underwater escape experience with friends and family so far! 

To start the week with some good news, we’re excited to roll out our first major “Summer & Feedback Update”, packed with bug fixes, many gameplay improvements, and new feedback systems to optimize your co-op interactions. 

Over the past weeks, our team has been closely watching players from around the world dive into the escape rooms we’ve designed with passion. Thanks to your streams, feedback, and messages, we've crafted a new patch aimed at enhancing the overall experience, and we can’t wait for you to try it.

Plus, to celebrate, the game is 25% off until August 17!

Scroll down for all the details included in the “Summer & Feedback Update 1.3.0”
Gameplay Improvements & Update
Global

New sound effects added

Localization updates across various languages

Main Game

You can now invert the Y-axis when playing with a mouse or gamepad

For Chinese players: the intro QR code now redirects to a website that doesn't require a VPN to access the Companion App

New feedback has been added when entering a code on a keypad

Rescue Submarine

Levers: Success feedback added. The machine now closes once the riddle is completed

Periscope: Improved collider to make switching between the keypad and the glasses smoother

Machine Room

Water Puzzle: Adjusted visuals for portholes #2 and #3 to make them easier to identify

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/011d67932d19c9dca472ac47e82d42d96bb3dee3.png"]

Canteen

Extended timer by an additional 10 minutes

Captain’s Cabin

Map: Updated lighthouse and water tank icons to reduce player confusion 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/0933657464c14af3a9dcc36e392ebd8e6c5a9fcc.png"]

Torpedo Room

Molecule Simulator: Poster updated for better clarity. A new validation button has been added to clarify keyboard interaction

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/744e85676f220bb26d3801df7c24d1f64b58d304.png"]

Torpedo Monitor:

Added more visual feedback to show how many characters are needed per round

A numerical hint has been added to help solve the second question

Step 1 localization has been revised for improved clarity

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/5e42faba3147c293958668e85a7efcb70c43f185.png"]
Companion App
A new alert panel warns users if their Companion App is not up to date

Machine Room

Water Codex: Portholes #2 and #3 have been adjusted for better visibility

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/e47d54555a7adf23f7cb9d91ff41605117acdc0b.jpg"]

Electricity Manual: Color changes to the pattern ensure players no longer need to plug cables in reverse*

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/7544aec0859aa22ca7b133066b58bc18394d96f0.jpg"]

Captain’s Cabin

Map Codex: Lighthouse and other icons have been updated to improve comprehension

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/d67bbc6f8eb1f7f06d3fc26ced5fd18d1edc2f7f.jpg"]

Torpedo Room

Torpedo Monitor Manual: Localization tweaks to Steps 1 and 3 for easier understanding

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544538/4f503ee350c0ce016300dd01a98c35ec0837fb47.jpg"]

Control Room

Geolocation Codex: A confirmation message now appears when deleting circles using the Trash Bin
Bug Fixes
Global

Minor bug fixes

Gamepad navigation has been improved, you can now cycle through all buttons correctly

Control Room

Military Strategy: Fixed a major issue where submarines could destroy ships outside of their range.

Geolocation: Fixed a bug that prevented circle placement on certain points when using the Undo function after using the Trash Bin.
